name: gulf-job-offer-check
description: Check a job offer in a Gulf country before accepting: basic wage against total package, allowances, what gratuity will be based on, visa and recruitment costs, probation and notice, flights, medical insurance, family benefits, the cost of living, and the signs of a fraudulent offer. Use when asked should I accept this job in Dubai, is this Gulf offer good, compare this package with my current salary, is this job offer a scam, or what should I negotiate in a Saudi offer. Produces a package breakdown, a monthly budget estimate from figures the user supplies, a red-flag check, the terms to negotiate, and questions to ask before signing. Distinct from salary-negotiation, which is general.
